name: task-pipeline
description: Thin orchestrator: a mandatory intake grill expands the task and pre-resolves what would stop later stages, then docs study, brainstorm, spec, plan, subagent build, tests, lint/deploy, post-deploy log check, docs/wiki sync — typed auto/manual gates, one provider-agnostic model confirmed up front, a super-ux UX track for user-facing tasks, and toggleable project-configurable release automation. Built on the superpowers skills; generic-portable.
